gold: Trifascicular block (Right bundle-branch block with alternating left anterior and left posterior fascicular block)

selector.rationale: The patient's ECG findings, including right bundle-branch block, left anterior fascicular block, and PR interval of 204 milliseconds, support cardiac conduction disease as the most likely diagnosis.
